title: MZ An somewhat custom button plugin

posts.author: LordLaxy
posts.body:
Hello There
So for something in my games I want you to be able to press a button that can activate a common event. It will be used to play a silly sound effect that will for a few seconds also actived a switch for some interactions in the world. Ive tried the costom keys plugin from reflector88 but that one didnt work. Atleast the plugin does but the common event function doesnt. Can someone help me find a plugin that can do the things I want to use?

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
You can try use mine:
Hakuen Studio Button Common Events for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Bind keyboard keys to common events!
